title: Microbiota-Derived Metabolites Associated with Oats and Bran Attenuate Inflammation and Oxidative Stress via the Keap1-Nrf2 Pathway in Zebrafish.
authors: Duan, Wen; Li, Tong; Zhang, Yuyu; Sun, Baoguo; Liu, Rui Hai
one_liner_zh: 该文研究燕麦微生物代谢物通过Keap1-Nrf2通路发挥抗氧化抗炎作用，分子对接仅针对小分子-蛋白，无蛋白质-DNA互作体系，与本课题无关。
abstract: BACKGROUND/OBJECTIVES: Oats and oat bran are rich in polyphenols and soluble fiber, which are metabolized by gut microbiota into bioactive compounds. Previous studies identified ursodeoxycholic acid (UDCA), 3-(3-hydroxyphenyl)propionic acid (3-HPP), and avenanthramide C (AVC) as key microbial metabolites with protective effects against colitis. METHODS: This study aimed to elucidate their antioxidant and anti-inflammatory activities and underlying mechanisms using LPS-induced RAW 264.7 macrophages and AAPH-induced oxidative stress in zebrafish embryos. All three metabolites significantly reduced intracellular reactive oxygen species (ROS), nitric oxide (NO), malondialdehyde (MDA), and pro-inflammatory cytokines (IL-6, TNF-alpha). They also restored mitochondrial membrane potential and enhanced superoxide dismutase (SOD) activity. RESULTS: In vivo, treatment improved zebrafish survival, normalized SOD activity to 76-89% of control levels, and decreased ROS and MDA by 2.4 to 3.8 fold, with UDCA showing the greatest efficacy. Molecular docking revealed strong binding affinities to Keap1, particularly UDCA, which interacted with residues Met577, Ala440, Val532, and Val486. qRT-PCR further demonstrated downregulation of Keap1 and upregulation of Nrf2 and SOD, indicating activation of the Keap1-Nrf2 pathway. CONCLUSIONS: Collectively, these findings show that oats and bran-derived microbial metabolites exert potent antioxidant and anti-inflammatory effects via modulation of the Keap1-Nrf2 axis. Among the metabolites, UDCA exhibited the strongest biological activity at equivalent concentrations. This study provides mechanistic insight into how microbiota-derived oat metabolites contribute to redox balance and immune regulation, supporting their potential as functional components in dietary strategies for managing oxidative stress-related inflammatory diseases.
abstract_zh: 背景/目的：燕麦和燕麦麸富含多酚和可溶性纤维，这些成分被肠道微生物群代谢为生物活性化合物。既往研究鉴定出熊去氧胆酸（UDCA）、3-(3-羟基苯基)丙酸（3-HPP）和燕麦蒽酰胺C（AVC）为对结肠炎具有保护作用的关键微生物代谢产物。方法：本研究旨在利用LPS诱导的RAW 264.7巨噬细胞和AAPH诱导的斑马鱼胚胎氧化应激模型，阐明其抗氧化和抗炎活性及潜在机制。所有三种代谢产物均显著降低细胞内活性氧（ROS）、一氧化氮（NO）、丙二醛（MDA）和促炎细胞因子（IL-6、TNF-α）水平。它们还恢复线粒体膜电位并增强超氧化物歧化酶（SOD）活性。结果：在体内实验中，处理改善了斑马鱼存活率，将SOD活性正常化至对照水平的76-89%，并使ROS和MDA降低2.4至3.8倍，其中UDCA表现出最大功效。分子对接显示与Keap1的强结合亲和力，尤其是UDCA，其与残基Met577、Ala440、Val532和Val486相互作用。qRT-PCR进一步证明Keap1下调以及Nrf2和SOD上调，表明Keap1-Nrf2通路被激活。结论：综合来看，这些发现表明燕麦和麸皮来源的微生物代谢产物通过调节Keap1-Nrf2轴发挥强效抗氧化和抗炎作用。在代谢产物中，UDCA在同等浓度下表现出最强的生物活性。本研究为微生物群来源的燕麦代谢产物如何促进氧化还原平衡和免疫调节提供了机制性见解，支持其作为管理氧化应激相关炎症性疾病的膳食策略中功能性成分的潜力。
